decisions.issues: Minor only: Nagoji's pale ridged brand sits nearer the elbow than a hand's width above the wrist (small, not letters, acceptable at this distance); a thin dark teal strip shows under Ibrahim's shoulder cloth beside the vest (reads as cloth lining, not a coat); Ibrahim is front-lit rather than backlit in the doorway; his scar has a faint pink tint but reads pale. Otherwise clean: hut interior with hearth smoke, slatted window, mat and gruel bowl; healer with grey-streaked low knot and undyed cloth over both shoulders, no blouse or gold; Ibrahim in cream pocketed vest, white shirt, striped shoulder cloth, white mundu, no coat, bare forehead; Nagoji bare-chested, moustache, clean chin, gold stud, rope burns, linen only on hands, ankle chafe; no fishermen, no text. Plain mud wall between the window and the door post above Nagoji holds both captions.

Wrong setting: drawn outdoors on a Portuguese fort quay with a fortress and church tower, ships, open sky, an iron wall ring with chain and hanging rope, barrels, and an extra Portuguese soldier in a morion with a pike. The script and panel 1.1 place this inside the healer's thatched hut with only Nagoji and Ibrahim. Figures themselves were good (Ibrahim crouched, left cheek and scar to camera, vest, no coat; Nagoji bare-chested, clean chin, stud), though Nagoji's linen runs up the forearms.
decisions.correction: SETTING CORRECTION: This panel is INDOORS, in the same healer's low house as panel 1.1, not outside. Draw the interior of a thatched fisherman's hut: mud-plastered wall behind Nagoji, low thatch eaves and rafters across the top, packed-earth floor swept smooth, the woven mat, soft slatted daylight from a wooden-barred window and a warm hearth glow; at most the healer half-seen at the hearth in the dim background. There is NO fort, quay, harbour, church tower, ship, open sky, stone masonry, iron wall ring, chain, hanging rope, barrel or crate, and NO soldier, guard, helmet or pike: the only men in frame are Nagoji and Ibrahim. Keep what worked: Nagoji seated at screen left on the mat with his back to the wall, bare-chested in the cream dhoti, loose curly hair, thick curled moustache, clean chin, small gold ear stud, rope burns on the chest, clean linen strips on the hands only, ending at the wrists; Ibrahim crouched on his heels at screen right facing him at eye level, forearms on his knees, white turban, short grey-flecked beard, his LEFT cheek with the pale healed scar toward camera, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, striped shoulder cloth, white mundu, no coat, forehead bare. Keep plain mud wall and thatch shadow above both heads, upper left and upper right, clear for two balloons.

decisions.issues: Wrong setting (open-air stone fort quay with crates, barrels, palms, harbour and an iron wall ring with rope) instead of the healer's hut. The brand on the forearm is drawn as looping cursive strokes that read as handwriting (pseudo-text). The forearm's hand is bare and gesturing open-palmed while the linen is wrapped around the elbow, and an extra hand grips that bandage, so the anatomy is confusing and the script's linen-wrapped hand resting on the knee is missing.
decisions.correction: SETTING, HAND AND BRAND CORRECTION: INDOORS in the same healer's low house as panel 1.1: mud-plastered wall, low thatch eaves, packed-earth floor, woven mat, soft slatted daylight and warm hearth glow; NO stone fort walls, quay, crates, barrels, palms, harbour, open sky, iron wall ring or hanging rope. Keep the over-the-shoulder framing that worked: Nagoji's bare back and shoulder, loose curly hair and small gold ear stud large in the right foreground, Ibrahim beyond at centre leaning in with his eyes fixed on the forearm, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, striped shoulder cloth, white turban, grey-flecked beard, no coat. Nagoji's LEFT forearm lies in the lower-left foreground, inner side turned up to camera, relaxed and still, not reaching or gesturing, its hand resting on his knee at the frame edge; that hand is wrapped in clean linen strips over the palm and knuckles that END AT THE WRIST, with nothing wrapped at the elbow or upper arm, and no other hand touching or gripping the arm. The brand on the bare inner forearm, a hand's width above the wrist, is a soft, shapeless, slightly shiny pale patch of raised, melted scar ridges about the size of a palm, with NO strokes, loops, curls or lines that could read as handwriting, letters, numerals or a symbol, and not red. Leave the mud wall and thatch shadow across the top of the frame, on both sides of Ibrahim's turban, clear for four short balloons.

decisions.issues: Close to usable (correct hut interior with beach doorway, open brass oil lamp, left cheek to camera, vest over white shirt, no coat, bare forehead, clear wall for lettering), but in this panel whose subject is the scar it is drawn as a glossy red line that reads as a fresh cut, against the pre-generation note's explicit 'thin pale line, no red or pink' and the script's 'bare pale line'. The hand tracing it is his RIGHT hand crossing the chest, while the script and panel 1.5 call for his LEFT thumb, which would break the 1.4 to 1.5 continuity of the same gesture.
decisions.correction: SCAR AND HAND CORRECTION: Keep this composition (tight on Ibrahim in three-quarter view with his LEFT cheek toward camera at screen right, white turban, short grey-flecked beard, cream vest over a white shirt, no coat, forehead bare, the dim hearth-lit hut interior with the beach doorway at the left edge and an open brass oil lamp, plain dim wall in the upper right and upper left clear for three lettering lines). Change two things. The scar is old and fully healed: a thin line PALER than his skin, a bare hairless parting through the beard from just below his left ear to the corner of his jaw, with no red, pink, maroon, dark or glossy wet line and nothing that reads as a fresh cut or blood. The hand is his LEFT hand, coming up from his left shoulder on the near, screen-right side with the elbow toward the lower right corner: the left thumb laid along the scar below the ear, the fingers loosely curled under the jaw, not covering his eyes, nose or mouth; his right hand stays down and out of frame. No rope or iron ring on the wall.

decisions.issues: Wrong setting: a dressed-stone room with an iron wall ring and hanging rope, opening onto a fortified harbour with a European watchtower and galleons, not the healer's thatched hut of panels 1.1 and 1.4. Ibrahim faces screen right, so the cheek shown is his RIGHT cheek and the scar is drawn on the wrong side; the doorway is at screen right instead of beyond the left edge as the pre-generation note specifies.
decisions.correction: SETTING AND SCAR-SIDE CORRECTION: INDOORS in the same healer's low house as panels 1.1 and 1.4: dim mud-plastered wall, thatch eaves, warm hearth light, at most an open clay or brass oil lamp; NO stone masonry, iron wall ring, hanging rope, fort tower, harbour wall or European ships. Mirror the staging so Ibrahim faces screen LEFT: the bright doorway and sea are off-panel beyond the LEFT edge, their daylight falling across his face from the left; Ibrahim large at centre-right in three-quarter view turned toward screen left, which puts his LEFT cheek and ear toward the camera with the old healed scar (a thin line paler than his skin, not red or pink) running from the left ear to the corner of the jaw; his LEFT hand raised from the near, screen-right arm with the thumb resting still on the scar and the fingers loose under the jaw; his eyes drifting past Nagoji toward that off-panel doorway, far away for a beat. Nagoji soft and out of focus in the lower-left foreground, back three-quarters to us and facing Ibrahim: bare shoulder with faint rope-burn marks, loose curly hair, the edge of his face in lost profile with the moustache tip and small gold ear stud, no shirt. Keep a plain, dim stretch of mud wall in the upper left above Nagoji's head clear for one caption and one short balloon, away from Ibrahim's face. Ibrahim in the cream vest over a white shirt, white turban, short grey-flecked beard, no coat, forehead bare, no ash.

decisions.issues: Minor only. Ibrahim is still crouched at the mat's edge in a dim hut interior (plaster wall, wooden posts, woven mat, open-flame brass lamp, no glass). His costume is right: cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, white mundu, white turban, grey-flecked beard, blue-striped shoulder cloth, no teal coat and no ash. The scar is on his anatomical LEFT, since he faces screen left. Nagoji appears only as a soft, faceless bare shoulder at the left edge, as the audit allowed. The scar is drawn reddish like the sheet, not pale. His expression is more a sceptical frown than a suppressed smile. He wears sandals indoors. The upper-left wall (x 0.05-0.35, y 0.02-0.28) and the upper-right wall (x 0.57-0.86, y 0.02-0.38) are clear for both balloons.

The only candidate, v01, fails. Ibrahim's head is turned toward screen right, so the visible scar sits on his anatomical RIGHT cheek, which mirrors the bible. He also looks sideways at the healer, but the script says he does not look at her. The setting is not the healer's thatched hut from 1.1 and 2.1. It is a bright open-sided shed with palm trees and stone buildings visible to the sky, a wooden post with an iron ring and coiled rope behind Nagoji, and barrels and crates. The lighting and room do not match 2.1. A thin panel border line is painted around the art. The healer is good: heavy-set, grey low knot, undyed cotton over both shoulders, no blouse, hands on hips. Nagoji is good too: bare-chested, clean chin, gold stud, linen hands.
decisions.correction: SETTING AND STAGING FIX: This is the same healer's low house as panels 1.1 and 2.1, fully indoors: mud-plastered walls, a palm-thatch roof on rough wooden rafters, a packed-earth floor swept smooth, a woven mat, clay pots, faint hearth smoke and warm slatted daylight through a wooden-slatted window. Do NOT draw stone masonry or a side open to the sky. Do NOT show palm trees or stone buildings outside, a wooden post with an iron ring or coiled rope, barrels or crates, or a panel border line. Stage it so Ibrahim's scar reads on his ANATOMICAL LEFT. The healer stands at screen LEFT, Nagoji sits on the mat at centre between them, and Ibrahim is STILL CROUCHED on his heels at screen RIGHT at the mat's edge. His face is in three-quarter view turned toward screen left, so his LEFT cheek, with the old pale scar from the left ear to the jaw, faces the camera; his right cheek is clean. His eyes stay on Nagoji, never on the healer, and he only tips his head slightly back toward her. Keep what worked. The healer stays exactly as drawn: heavy-set, grey-streaked hair in a loose low knot, undyed off-white cotton over both shoulders, no blouse, no gold, hands on hips, a dull betel tint on her lips only, snorting. Nagoji stays exactly as drawn: bare-chested, cream captivity dhoti, hair loose, clean chin, small gold ear stud, linen-wrapped hands, faint rope burns. Keep Ibrahim's cream pocketed vest over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, the blue-striped shoulder cloth, the white mundu and the white turban, with no ash. Leave plain thatch and wall above the healer and above Ibrahim for the two lettering areas.

decisions.issues: The only candidate, v01, fails. A Portuguese soldier in a morion helmet and breastplate with a spear stands in the doorway, which is a story error, since no guards are at the healer's house. The room is a stone cell with a barred window and an iron ring with hanging ropes, which reads as a Goa dungeon, not the thatched hut from 1.1 and 2.1. A tiled European building and a fort show through the door. Ibrahim turns toward screen right, so his visible scar sits on his anatomical RIGHT cheek, mirrored. A panel border line is painted around the art. Ibrahim's rising pose and costume are good, and so is Nagoji (bare-chested, clean chin, gold stud, linen hands).
decisions.correction: SETTING AND CAST FIX: This is the healer's low house from panels 1.1, 2.1 and 2.2, a Kerala fishing-village hut: mud-plastered walls, a palm-thatch roof on rough wooden rafters, a packed-earth floor, a woven mat, clay pots and warm slatted daylight through a wooden-slatted window. Do NOT draw stone blocks, iron rings, ropes or chains on the wall, or a barred window. Draw NO Portuguese soldier or guard of any kind, and no helmet, breastplate or spear anywhere. Show no fort or tiled European buildings, and no panel border line. Only Ibrahim and Nagoji are in frame. Stage it so Ibrahim's scar reads on his ANATOMICAL LEFT. Nagoji sits on the mat at screen LEFT. Ibrahim, at screen RIGHT, is half risen from his crouch with one hand pushing on his knee, turning his face back toward screen left to Nagoji, so his LEFT cheek, with the old pale scar from the left ear to the jaw, faces the camera; his right cheek is clean. His expression is mild. Keep what worked. Keep Ibrahim's rising pose and costume: cream pocketed vest over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, blue-striped shoulder cloth, white mundu, white turban, grey-flecked beard, no ash. Keep Nagoji bare-chested in the cream captivity dhoti, hair loose, clean chin, small gold ear stud, linen-wrapped hands and faint rope burns, with his inner left forearm turned down. Leave plain thatch and wall in the upper centre for two lettering areas, clear of both faces.

decisions.issues: Minor only. This is a strong echo of Chapter 1, 6.5: the black mare's head, neck and wind-tossed mane in misty dawn light over water at screen left. It dissolves into ragged ink splatter with no border. Nagoji's still face sits at centre-right: bare-shouldered, hair loose, thick curled moustache, clean chin with light stubble. The cracked hut wall and wooden-slatted window behind him fit the house. There is no text. The ear ornament is a tiny two-bead drop rather than a flush stud, but it reads as a small stud at panel size. The mare has a small pale forehead mark, which matches the front view on her sheet. The healing marks on his shoulder are faint, not gore.

The only candidate, v01, fails. The room is a stone dungeon with a heavy chain hanging from an iron ring on the wall and an iron-strapped plank door, not the thatched hut from 1.1 and 2.1. Through the doorway are a stone quay, a fort or tiled building and a European sailing ship, which read as Goa. Ibrahim stands fully front-lit with his face clear, not as the turbaned silhouette against the light that the script asks for. Nagoji's action is good: his RIGHT bandaged hand is flat on the wall as he rises, his left forearm is down, and he is bare-chested with a clean chin, gold stud and linen hands.
decisions.correction: SETTING FIX: This is the healer's low house from panel 1.1, NOT a prison: mud-plastered walls, a palm-thatch roof on rough wooden rafters, a packed-earth floor, a woven mat with a clay bowl, clay pots and faint hearth smoke. Do NOT draw stone blocks, chains, iron rings or shackles on the wall, or an iron-strapped plank door. Show no stone quay, fort, tiled buildings or European ships outside. The doorway is at screen RIGHT, as in 1.1: a low opening in the mud wall under the thatch eave, filled with bright white-gold coastal daylight, beach sand and a few palms. Ibrahim stands in that doorway, half turned to go, as a dark backlit SILHOUETTE. Show the outline of the white turban and his stocky vest-and-mundu shape against the glare, with his face in deep shadow and no features readable. Keep what worked: Nagoji at screen left, rising from the mat with his RIGHT bandaged hand flat on the mud wall and his left forearm turned in toward his body. He stays bare-chested in the cream captivity dhoti, hair loose, clean chin, small gold ear stud and faint healing rope burns. Leave plain dim wall and thatch in the upper centre, between Nagoji and the doorway, and on the thatch above the doorway for three lettering areas, clear of his face and his hand on the wall.

decisions.issues: Minor only. Nagoji's collarless tunic shows two tiny buttons at the neck slit (script says no buttons). Ibrahim walks beside Nagoji rather than clearly leading. Ibrahim's LEFT-cheek scar is not readable at this size. The net-mender looks toward the travellers rather than down the path to the sea. Otherwise clean: Nagoji has the moustache, clean chin, gold stud, tied-back hair, bare feet and linen-wrapped wrists. Ibrahim wears the pocketed vest, white mundu and turban with no teal coat and no ash. The well, children and net-menders are present, there is no text, and clear sky at top centre (x 0.42-0.68, y 0-0.12) holds the caption.

v01 is rejected. Ibrahim has white ash marks on his forehead, which the bible allows only from panel 5.3. His scar is drawn on his RIGHT cheek, from the right ear to the jaw, so it is mirrored. Nagoji wears sandals (he is barefoot in 3.1). His tunic has a buttoned placket and a stand collar, against the script's no buttons, no collar. The men are large in frame and nearly side by side, not small and in single file. The deep sunset is also much darker than the afternoon light of panels 1, 3 and 4.
decisions.correction: Make this a wide shot with low detail. Draw both men SMALL in the frame, each figure no more than about a third of the frame height, walking single file along a raised earth bund between flooded paddy plots: Ibrahim in front, Nagoji a few paces behind with his head turned aside, as if catching a scent on the breeze. Ibrahim has NO marks of any kind on his forehead (no ash, no white lines, no tilak). His scar runs only on his LEFT side, from the left ear to the jaw, and never on the right cheek. He wears the pale pocketed vest over a white shirt and white mundu, a white turban and a short grey-flecked beard, with no coat. Nagoji is BAREFOOT, with no sandals. He wears a loose, collarless cream homespun tunic-shirt pulled on over the head, with no buttons, no placket and no collar band, over a plain village dhoti. His hair is tied back, he has a small gold ear stud, a thick moustache and a clean chin, and his wrists are wrapped in clean linen. Light: late afternoon turning toward evening. The sun is low above the palms and the sky is only beginning to darken, giving warm golden light that matches the village panel before it, reflected in strips in the paddy water. No deep dusk, no night. Keep a large clear area of sky in the upper half for two balloons.

decisions.issues: Acceptable, with these notes. The sky is bright midday blue, while 3.2 calls for a darkening sky; this is close to panels 1 and 4, but the 3.2 correction asks for late-afternoon light to bridge the gap. A small crenellated hill fort sits on the far hill at top left (x 0.05-0.15, y 0.16-0.22), likely bleeding in from the reference sheet's Deccan backdrop. It is period-plausible but unscripted, and the top-left caption may cover it. Nagoji is seated, where 3.2 has him walking. There is light stubble on his jaw, which is allowed just after captivity. His likeness is strong: thick curled moustache, gold stud, collarless tunic with no buttons, linen-wrapped wrists, eyes closed, breathing in. Pepper vines with berry spikes climb the support tree at right. There is no text, and the clear sky band across the top holds all three lettering areas.

Minor only. The carter has a faint thin moustache, though the script says clean-shaven; he is not a principal, but later carter panels should follow one look. The light is bright daytime rather than late afternoon. A small whitewashed church with a bell tower sits on the distant shore, which is period-plausible. Ibrahim's LEFT scar is faint. The script beat is fully met: an open two-wheeled cart with spoked wheels and no hood, two white bullocks under a yoke, and a thin bare-chested carter with a topknot and goad stick at the yoke. The plain unmarked sacks and palm-leaf baskets are there, one sack open on wrinkled black peppercorns, and Ibrahim (vest, no coat, no ash) rests his hand in it. Nagoji stands at the left edge with tied-back hair, gold stud and a bandaged wrist. There is no text, and the sky from x 0.45 to 0.85, y 0.02 to 0.25 is clear for both balloons.

v01 is rejected on setting. The beat is the same moment and place as 3.4's small inland clearing, but v01 is set on a harbour waterfront: a masonry building wall behind Nagoji and moored masted ships on open water, with the sun disc setting on the horizon. That contradicts the clearing in panel 4 (shade tree, scrub, distant hills) and 3.1's 'inland, away from the shore'. It also jumps from panel 4's daylight to full sunset. The figures themselves are good. Nagoji has his hair tied in a knot, the gold stud, the moustache, light stubble and bandaged wrists. Ibrahim has the vest, no coat and no ash, and is half turned at the yoke, looking back.
decisions.correction: Keep this composition. Nagoji is in the left foreground, seen from behind in three-quarter view, level, watching Ibrahim: hair tied back in a knot, small gold ear stud, thick moustache, collarless cream tunic, wrists wrapped in clean linen. Ibrahim stands beyond at the bullocks' yoke, half turned, looking back at him, in the pale pocketed vest over a white shirt and white mundu, white turban, short grey-flecked beard, no coat and no forehead marks. Keep the same spoked two-wheeled cart loaded with plain sacks and the two white bullocks facing right. Set it in the SAME small inland clearing as the previous panel. A large shade tree trunk stands behind Nagoji at the left in place of any building, over dry packed earth with dappled shade, with palms and scrub and distant blue hills. There is NO sea, harbour, boats, ships, masts or masonry wall, because the men have walked inland away from the shore. Light: warm late afternoon, with the sun low behind the trees and not a sun disc setting on a horizon. Golden rim light catches Ibrahim's turban and beard under a pale gold sky. The thin young bare-chested carter with a topknot may stand at the bullocks' heads at far right. Leave the upper middle sky clear for one balloon.

decisions.issues: v01 (only candidate): the costume and the shrug are right (white turban, grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, white mundu, no teal coat, no ash, sidelong glance out of frame, Nagoji off-panel). It fails on two counts. (1) The scar is on the wrong side. The clear scar line runs from his RIGHT ear (screen left) down across the right cheek, and the left cheek has at most a faint stroke. (2) The setting and light are wrong. It shows an open beach with surf, sand, fishing nets, baskets and two sailing boats, in flat midday blue-sky light. Pages 3.2 to 3.5 have walked inland through the paddies to a small clearing by the cart in late-afternoon or sunset light, and the pre-generation note asks for 'late-afternoon light in the clearing by the cart'.
decisions.correction: Setting correction: this panel continues 3.4 and 3.5 in the small inland clearing by the cart, NOT on a beach. Behind Ibrahim show only the open, hoodless spoked bullock cart with plain unmarked sacks, coconut palms, a pepper-vine support tree and flooded paddy, in warm, low, late-afternoon golden light with long shadows. No sea, no surf, no sand beach, no boats or ships, no fishing nets or baskets. Keep Ibrahim exactly as drawn: white turban, short grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, white mundu, striped shoulder cloth, the careful open-palmed shrug, and the sidelong glance out of frame to screen right, with Nagoji off-panel. Put the thin pale scar ONLY on his LEFT cheek, running from the LEFT ear down to the jaw. That is the screen-right side of his face as he faces the viewer. There must be no scar on his right cheek (screen left). Forehead bare. Keep the upper right sky clear and low-detail for the two lettering lines.

decisions.issues: v01 (only candidate): the setting is badly wrong. Behind the cart are a Portuguese-style fort with a church tower and a cross, European soldiers in morion helmets with spears, and other buildings. This scene is in the rural Kerala clearing far from any town, and soldiers and a church tower are anachronistic for this road. The light is also harsh midday rather than the late afternoon of 3.4 to 4.1. Nagoji's hair hangs loose instead of tied back (chapter 5 bible row from page 3). Ibrahim's grip closes around the bandaged wrist rather than hand to hand. Ibrahim himself is correct: vest over a white shirt, white mundu, no coat, no ash, the scar on his left cheek.
decisions.correction: Setting correction: this is the same inland clearing as 3.4, 3.5 and 4.1, far from any town. Behind Ibrahim and the cart show only coconut palms, paddy and open sky in warm late-afternoon golden light. NO fort, NO walls, NO church, tower or cross, NO European soldiers, helmets or spears, and no buildings at all. Keep the composition that worked: Ibrahim up on the open, hoodless spoked cart with plain unmarked sacks, looking down, his broad hand held out. Show a proper palm-to-palm grip on Nagoji's linen-wrapped RIGHT hand, not a grip around the wrist. Nagoji is in the near foreground, seen from behind and below, his cream homespun sleeve down to the wrap and his small gold ear stud showing. His long curly hair must be TIED BACK at the nape, not loose. Ibrahim: cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, white mundu, no coat, forehead bare, pale scar on his LEFT cheek. Keep the upper left sky clear and low-detail for two lettering lines.

decisions.issues: v01 (only candidate): Ibrahim has white horizontal ash or sandal stripes painted across his forehead under the turban. The chapter 5 checks and the bible require a bare forehead until 5.3, which makes this a hard reject. Minor issues: Nagoji's hair is loose on his shoulders rather than tied back. The carter has a moustache, but the script says clean-shaven. The cart fills a lot of the frame rather than reading small on a broad road. Everything else works: the dusk sky, the hoodless spoked cart with unmarked sacks, two pale humped bullocks, fireflies over wet paddy, the tiered Kerala temple, a brass deepastambham with open wick cups (no glass), the costumes, and clear sky for the one small line.
decisions.correction: Forehead correction: Ibrahim's forehead must be completely bare below the white turban. No white ash stripes, no sandal paste, no tilak or marks of any kind; the ash comes only later, at the wayside shrine. Keep everything else that worked: the dusk sky shifting from bruised grey to deep blue, the open spoked cart with unmarked sacks, the two pale grey humped bullocks, fireflies over the wet paddy, the low tiered Kerala temple with the brass deepastambham of open oil-wick cups, Ibrahim in the cream vest over a white shirt and white mundu, and Nagoji in the cream tunic-shirt with bandaged hands and a clean chin. Three further fixes. Tie Nagoji's long curly hair back at the nape, not loose on his shoulders. Make the carter clean-shaven with no moustache (still bare-chested, short mundu, small topknot, goad stick), walking at the bullocks' heads. Pull the camera a little further back so the cart reads small on the broad road. Keep the upper sky clear for the one small lettering line.

decisions.issues: v01 (only candidate): the setting is wrong. The two men sit among sacks and crates on a harbour quay, with masted ships, water, a stone fortress with lit windows, a wooden crane and a hanging chain with an iron ring. The scene should be on the sacks of the bullock cart on the inland road at dusk, continuing 4.3 (paddy, fireflies, temple). The figures are good: Nagoji at screen left (clean chin, curled moustache, gold stud, cream tunic-shirt, bandaged hands on knees) and Ibrahim at screen right facing him, left cheek and scar to camera, vest over a white shirt, no coat, no ash. The setting break with the neighbouring panels is disqualifying, and the hanging chain and ring are an unwanted gallows-like prop.
decisions.correction: Setting correction: the two men sit on the plain unmarked sacks in the bed of the open, hoodless spoked bullock cart on the rural road inland, continuing 4.3. Behind them show only darkening paddy fields, fireflies, coconut palms and a deep blue dusk sky, with perhaps the cart's wooden side rail at the edge of frame. NO harbour, NO sea or water's edge, NO ships or masts, NO fort or stone walls, NO crane, beam, chain, hook or hanging ring. Keep the two-shot that worked. Nagoji at screen left: bare-headed, curly hair tied back, thick curled moustache, clean chin, small gold ear stud, cream tunic-shirt, bandaged hands resting on his knees. Ibrahim at screen right, facing him so that his LEFT cheek and the thin pale scar from ear to jaw face the camera: white turban, grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, white mundu, no coat, forehead bare. Light them with the cool last blue light. Keep the top third of the frame clear, low-detail sky for three lettering lines.

decisions.issues: v01 (only candidate): the setting, light and pose are all wrong. It is bright daylight on a stone rampart, with a sea bay, a hilltop town with a European church-like building, barrels, crates and an awning. It should be a closer shot on the same axis as 4.4, the two men seated on the cart sacks in the last blue dusk light on the inland road. Nagoji stands with arms folded instead of sitting. Ibrahim touches the scar with his RIGHT hand crossing his body, but the script asks for his LEFT thumb. The scar is painted reddish rather than pale. The faces and costumes are otherwise on model: Nagoji with a clean chin and gold stud, Ibrahim with no coat and no ash.
decisions.correction: Setting and pose correction: this is a closer shot on the same axis as 4.4. The two men are still SEATED on the unmarked sacks in the open bullock cart on the rural road at dusk, in the cool last blue light, with only dark paddy, palms and a deep blue sky behind. NO daylight, NO fort walls or ramparts, NO sea, harbour or town, NO church or European buildings, NO barrels, crates or awnings. Nagoji at screen left, bandaged hands resting on his knees (not arms folded), meeting Ibrahim's look flat and even: bare-headed, curly hair tied back, thick curled moustache, clean chin, small gold ear stud, cream tunic-shirt. Ibrahim at screen right, facing him with his head tilted so his LEFT cheek faces the camera. He raises his LEFT hand (the arm nearer the camera, not crossing his body) and rests the LEFT thumb on the thin PALE, not red, scar that runs from his left ear to the jaw. Keep his white turban, grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt and white mundu; no coat, forehead bare. Leave the upper sky clear and low-detail for two lettering lines.

decisions.issues: v01 gets Ibrahim right: profile facing screen left with the scar on his LEFT cheek, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, no teal coat, bare forehead, and an open brass bowl lamp on chains at the cart rail. The setting is wrong, though. Behind him is a harbour: moored sailing ships, lit water, a stone quay with stacked blocks and a walled fort with a domed tower and lit windows. That puts the cart in a port, which breaks continuity with the inland road over wet paddy fields in 4.3, the village in 5.2 and the page's move 'into the hills'. He also seems to sit beside the cart at quay level rather than up on the sacks.
decisions.correction: Keep Ibrahim exactly as drawn: profile facing screen left with the pale scar from his LEFT ear to the jaw toward the camera, white turban, short grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, no coat, bare forehead. Keep the small open brass bowl lamp with its lit wick hanging on short chains from the cart's front rail behind him. Change only the setting. He sits up on the grain sacks of the bullock cart on the inland country road between wet paddy fields at dusk, the same road as the previous wide panel. Behind his head show only the last of the deep blue sky, a thin band of fading orange at the horizon, black silhouettes of coconut palms and low distant hills. No sea, river mouth, harbour, quay or stone wharf; no ships, masts or sails; no fort, town walls, domes or lit buildings. Keep the upper-left sky empty and low-detail for one balloon.

decisions.issues: Minor only. Nagoji's hair looks mostly loose behind his shoulders rather than clearly tied back. One woman in the far-left doorway seems to wear a red fitted upper garment under her white wrap. A distant lit silhouette at the centre horizon could read as a towered temple. Everything required is right: open clay lamps in the doorways; the cart lamp is an open brass bowl on chains; bare-chested boys in loincloths, with the pointing boy's face visible and his arm aimed at the men on the sacks; Nagoji has the moustache, clean chin, gold stud, cream tunic-shirt and bandaged wrists; Ibrahim has no coat and no ash and calls back over his shoulder; the carter is right. The sky in the upper left and centre has room for both balloons.

Nagoji's small gold ear stud is missing: his ear is visible and the lobe is bare. He is a small background figure, so this is barely noticeable, but it could be retouched in. No carter is drawn, and Nagoji holds the reins. Everything else is right: the shrine under a tree hung with cloth strips and bangles, a small open clay lamp at the stone image, an old woman in a white wrap over both shoulders with no blouse pressing one grey-white thumb smear of ash onto Ibrahim's forehead while she looks up and past him toward the cart, Ibrahim offering a coin, his LEFT-cheek scar showing, no coat, the cart's hanging brass lamp with an open flame and no glass. The sky in the upper centre-right is clear for the balloon.

v01 breaks several hard rules. The cart light is a glass box lantern with a chimney, which is banned in Kerala settings. The background is a stone fortress gate and a harbour with ships, lit by a full moon. Portuguese-style soldiers in morion helmets with halberds and red tunics stand by. A brown horse stands where the bullocks should be. None of this matches the roadside shrine in 5.3 or the forest road in 5.5. The art also has a painted black panel border. What works: Ibrahim's single ash smear, his sly open-palm shrug, Nagoji's sidelong look with a raised brow, and both costumes.
decisions.correction: Keep both men's costumes, expressions and gestures as drawn. Nagoji sits on the grain sacks with one eyebrow raised and a dry sidelong look; he has the thick curled moustache, clean chin, small gold ear stud, cream tunic-shirt, hair tied back and bandaged hands. Ibrahim is half-way up, climbing back onto the cart beside him, one palm turned up in a shrug, with a sly half-smile; he wears the white turban, short grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt and white mundu, no coat, and one faint grey-white thumb smear of ash on his forehead below the turban. Change the setting to the same place as the previous panel: the country road beside the wayside shrine at dusk turning to night, a tree hung with cloth strips behind, coconut palms and dark fields beyond, deep blue sky. The cart is the same wooden bullock cart with two small pale grey humped bullocks: no horse. Its only light is the small hanging brass bowl oil lamp with an open wick on short chains: no glass, no chimney, no panes, no box lantern. No soldiers, helmets or halberds, no fort, no stone walls or gateway, no harbour, ships or moon on water. Draw no panel border. Keep the upper sky clear and low-detail for two balloons.

decisions.issues: The composition works well: a misty, dark-leaved canopy, the open brass bowl lamp on chains, the carter with a topknot and goad, two pale grey humped bullocks, Nagoji (moustache, clean chin, gold stud, cream tunic, bandaged wrists) and Ibrahim (no coat) on the sacks, and a Nair watcher at the right with a topknot, dark sash, spear and round shield, and no turban. Ibrahim's details break continuity, though. His ash is two or three crisp white horizontal stripes, a tripundra, instead of the single faint thumb smear from 5.3, which the note forbids. He wears a gold earring, which belongs only to Nagoji. There is also a pale streak on his RIGHT temple and cheek, the camera side as he looks right, which reads as the scar mirrored to the wrong side. The cart also fills about half the frame, though the script wants it small under the canopy.
decisions.correction: Keep the composition, lighting and cast as drawn: the misty forest road climbing under a dark-leaved canopy, the open brass bowl lamp on chains as the only warm light, the bare-chested carter with a topknot, the two pale grey humped bullocks, Nagoji and Ibrahim on the sacks, and the Nair watcher half in shadow at the tree line on the right, bare-chested, with a topknot, dark sash, white mundu hitched to the knee, upright spear and small round shield. Fix Ibrahim only. His ash is ONE faint grey-white thumb smear in the centre of his forehead, the same mark the old woman made in the previous panel: no horizontal lines, no stripes, no dot. He wears no earring of any kind; only Nagoji has the small gold ear stud. His scar runs from the LEFT ear to the jaw only. As he looks toward the watcher at screen right, his right cheek and temple face the camera and must stay clean, with no streak or mark. Draw the cart a little smaller in the frame, about 40 percent of the width, with more canopy and mist above it. Keep the misty upper centre clear and low-detail for three balloons.

decisions.issues: Clean pick. Dusk bazaar, red stone compound wall and wooden gate, rutted earth. The cart has two pale grey humped bullocks, a thin bare-chested carter with a topknot, and a hanging brass lamp with an open wick. Two Nair guards in white jackets, sashes and topknots, with spears and round shields and no turbans. The speaking guard (left) faces the cart. Ibrahim matches: white turban, grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, white mundu, no coat. Nagoji matches: hair tied back, thick moustache, clean chin, gold stud, cream tunic-shirt, bandaged wrists. Every lamp is an open brass lamp. The open sky above the wall at top centre has room for both balloons. Minor: no ash is visible on Ibrahim's forehead (allowed, since the chapter check forbids ash). The far lights inside the compound are soft glows, not lanterns you can read as such. Panels 6.2 to 6.5 must be regenerated to match this dusk, lamp-lit setting.

Wrong setting and time of day. It shows bright midday sun on a harbour: open sea, ships' masts, and a European fortress and church on a palm-lined headland. The grey-tan stone walls belong to Goa, not the inland Travancore compound. Panel 6.1 is deep dusk in an inland bazaar at a red stone wall lit by brass oil lamps. Nagoji sits on a pile of sacks against a wall instead of on the cart. His hair hangs loose, but from page 3 it must be tied back. The characters themselves work: Ibrahim's vest, shirt, mundu, faint ash and LEFT-side scar are right; the Nair guard's jacket, sash, topknot, spear and shield are right; Nagoji's face and clean chin are right.
decisions.correction: Same place and moment as panel 6.1. Deep blue dusk at the red laterite stone compound wall and heavy wooden gate of a small inland bazaar. The only light is warm: open brass and clay oil lamps in wall niches and on stalls, and the small brass lamp with an open wick hanging from the cart. No sea, harbour, ships, masts, European church, fortress or headland, and no daylight or blue daytime sky. Nagoji sits high on the unmarked sacks in the bed of the same open spoked wooden bullock cart, with the two pale grey humped bullocks partly in frame. His hair is tied back at the nape, not loose. He wears the cream collarless long-sleeved tunic-shirt, and his wrists are bandaged. The Nair guard stands on the ground looking UP at him. Keep the guard exactly as drawn: short white jacket, white mundu hitched to the knee, dark sash, topknot, spear, round shield, no turban. Keep Ibrahim exactly as drawn: white turban, grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white shirt, white mundu, striped shoulder cloth, a single faint grey-white ash smear, and the scar on his LEFT cheek, visible because he faces screen left. He stands by the cart wheel and jerks his thumb toward Nagoji. Leave the darkening sky above the wall clear for three balloons.

decisions.issues: 1. Ibrahim's scar is mirrored: he faces screen right, so the scar near his ear is on his RIGHT cheek. 2. His ash is three white horizontal lines (a tripundra), against the PRE-GENERATION NOTE that asks for a single faint smear, not lines. 3. The official has a red dot on his forehead (forbidden) and a thin chain or thread across his chest. He holds a flat writing board instead of palm leaves. 4. Doorways show bright daylight and blue sky, but the scene follows the dusk arrival of 6.1. 5. Background hall guards and one seated figure wear white turbans; the Nair men should be bare-headed with topknots. 6. A black panel border is painted around the art. 7. Nagoji's hair is in a high crown bun, which reads as a Kerala topknot, not tied back at the nape as in 6.1. What works: the carved pillars, the open brass chain lamps, the seated bare-chested men in white mundus angled to the platform, Ibrahim leaning to whisper with a cupped hand, the costumes, and the low-detail rafters for balloons.
decisions.correction: Keep this composition: carved wooden pillars, open brass oil lamps on chains, seated bare-chested men in white mundus angled toward the official, and Ibrahim leaning to whisper in Nagoji's ear as they approach. Make it night. Every doorway and window shows dark night or deep shadow, with no daylight, blue sky or sunlit walls; the hall is lit only by the brass lamps. Ibrahim's scar is on his LEFT cheek only. To show it, put Ibrahim on the screen-right side of Nagoji, facing screen left as he leans in, so his left cheek faces the camera. Otherwise, if he faces screen right, his visible right cheek must have NO scar. His ash is one faint grey-white smudge on the forehead below the turban, not three lines. The official has a completely bare forehead: no red dot, no sandal paste, no ash, no lines. No chain, thread or cord crosses his chest; he wears only the plain white shoulder cloth. He holds a narrow bundle of blank palm-leaf strips and a thin iron stylus, not a board or paper. Every guard and seated man is bare-headed with a Kerala topknot, with no turbans anywhere in the hall. Nagoji's hair is tied back low at the nape as in panel 6.1, not in a crown bun. Draw no border or frame line around the image.

decisions.issues: Wrong setting and anachronistic guards. It shows an outdoor veranda in bright daylight with a sea fortress, battlements and palms behind. The two guards are Portuguese-style soldiers in steel morion helmets, leather jerkins and breastplates; they should be Nair men. The official sits in a European cane-backed armchair beside a turned-leg side table, instead of cross-legged on the raised platform inside the lamp-lit hall of 6.3. He holds a paper sheet with ruled pseudo-writing lines, not a palm leaf. The over-shoulder framing works: Ibrahim's turban and beard edge in lost profile, Nagoji's tied-back curls and gold stud. The official's look works: round face, topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, shoulder cloth.
decisions.correction: Set this inside the same low hall as panel 6.3, at night. Carved wooden pillars, open brass oil lamps hanging on chains, a plain dark wall and dim rafters behind the official. No sky, sea, fort, battlements, palms or daylight. The official sits cross-legged on a low raised wooden platform, with no chair and no table. In his lap is a narrow bundle of blank palm-leaf strips (no paper, no writing or lines on them) and a thin iron stylus. Keep his look exactly as drawn: heavy, round amused face, Kerala topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, plain white shoulder cloth, no forehead marks. Any guards are Nair men: bare-headed with topknots, short white jackets or bare-chested, white mundus hitched to the knee, dark sashes, spears and small round shields. No helmets, breastplates, leather jerkins or European soldiers. Keep the over-the-shoulder framing: Ibrahim at screen left from behind in lost profile, with white turban, beard edge, cream vest over a white shirt and striped shoulder cloth; Nagoji at screen right from behind, hair tied back, gold stud, cream tunic-shirt. Leave the dark wall above the official's head clear for two balloons.

decisions.issues: 1. It is a photorealistic render, unlike the inked, coloured illustration style of the other panels. 2. The official sits in a European chair at a heavy wooden desk with a pen or brush, not on the platform with palm leaf and stylus as in 6.3 and 6.4. 3. Daylight and palms show through the doorway at the back. 4. The background guards wear white turbans. 5. The foreground stranger, who must be Nagoji, has a full beard and wears a dark sleeveless tunic with a grey shawl. Nagoji has a clean chin and the cream tunic-shirt. What works: the official's face and build (round, heavy, topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, white shoulder cloth), the brass chain lamps, and the clear wall above his head.
decisions.correction: Draw this in the same inked, coloured graphic-novel illustration style as panels 6.1 and 6.3, not photographic or painterly-realistic. Same night hall as 6.3: dark wooden pillars, open brass oil lamps on chains, no daylight, palms or open doorway to the outside. Tight on the official, sitting cross-legged on his low wooden platform. No chair, desk or table. Keep his face and build exactly as drawn: heavy, round patient face, grey-streaked Kerala topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, plain white shoulder cloth, no forehead marks, no chain or thread. A thin pointed iron stylus is poised above a single blank palm-leaf strip, with no pen, brush, ink or paper. His eyes look up toward the viewer's side of the frame, where the stranger stands. Leave the stranger out of frame. If he must appear, show only an out-of-focus edge of Nagoji's shoulder in the cream collarless tunic-shirt, with no face and no beard. Keep any background guards bare-headed with topknots, with no turbans. Keep the plain wall above the official's head clear for one small balloon.

decisions.issues: v01 has the wrong setting and the wrong court. Nagoji and Ibrahim are good: Nagoji has a clean chin, curled moustache, gold stud, cream tunic-shirt and dhoti, bandaged hands and bare feet; Ibrahim wears the cream pocketed vest with no teal coat. The problem is everything around them. It reads as a Portuguese tribunal: two soldiers in morion helmets and breastplates, a European in a red brocade robe on a carved European chair with a quill and inkwell, and a black-cassocked priest wearing a cross. The Nair official (bare torso, topknot) is missing, and palm gardens show in daylight through the open sides instead of the evening lamplit hall. Ibrahim's ash is also a crisp band with a dot rather than one faint smear.
decisions.correction: Setting is the Travancore coastal official's low hall at evening, NOT a Portuguese court: carved dark wooden pillars, a timber-and-tile roof, open brass oil lamps hanging on chains, a packed-earth floor with a woven mat, and only seated Nair men (bare-chested, white mundus, hair in topknots) around the mat in warm lamplight. Absolutely no Portuguese soldiers, morion helmets or breastplates, no priest, cassock or cross, no European robed figure, no European chair, quill or inkwell, and no daylight garden view through open sides. Keep the official off-panel at screen right, with Nagoji's upright gaze aimed up toward him. If any of him shows, show only the edge of his slightly raised wooden platform with a palm-leaf bundle and a bare brown arm with a plain white shoulder cloth. Keep Nagoji and Ibrahim exactly as drawn in the previous attempt. Nagoji: barefoot in the collarless cream tunic-shirt and dhoti, bandaged hands clasped, hair tied back at the nape, clean chin, thick curled moustache, small gold stud. Ibrahim: half a step behind at his shoulder in the cream pocketed vest over a white shirt and white mundu, white turban, short grey-flecked beard. Make Ibrahim's ash a single faint grey-white smear with no dot. Leave the dark roof beams at upper left and a plain shadowed wall at upper right low-detail for the two lettering areas.

decisions.issues: Acceptable. It is a single full-frame close-up with no inset. An older man's bare, hairy brown hand cuts a few abstract scratches into a corded palm-leaf bundle; the strokes do not form any legible script. Lighting is an open brass oil lamp, and the upper third is a plain grey wall with room for both lettering lines. Minor points: the rendering is photographic rather than the inked line-and-wash of 7.1, 7.3 and 7.4, and the top leaf reads slightly like a wooden board.

Wrong location. v01 puts the scene outdoors on a Goa fort rampart: a harbour with ships, a sea fort and a white church behind, and two Portuguese soldiers in morion helmets and breastplates flanking Nagoji. The camera is level rather than looking down from the platform. What works: the official's foreground (bare shoulder, plain white shoulder cloth, grey-streaked topknot) and Nagoji (clean chin, curled moustache, gold stud, long plain sleeves with the brand hidden, bandaged hands held before him). His hair is loose rather than tied back.
decisions.correction: The scene is INSIDE the same low evening hall as 6.3 and 7.1, not on a fort rampart. No sea, harbour, ships, sea fort, church or open sky. Absolutely no Portuguese soldiers, morion helmets, breastplates or red-and-white uniforms. Camera is behind and slightly above the seated official on his raised wooden platform, looking DOWN at Nagoji standing on the packed-earth floor below. Behind Nagoji, softly lit by open brass oil lamps hanging on chains: carved dark wooden pillars and seated bare-chested Nair men in white mundus with topknots. Keep the official's foreground exactly as before: bare brown shoulder, plain white shoulder cloth, grey-streaked Kerala topknot, no turban and no thread, head tipped down toward Nagoji's LEFT forearm at screen right. Keep Nagoji as before: facing camera, clean chin, thick curled moustache, small gold stud, collarless cream tunic-shirt with plain long sleeves down to the wrist wraps (brand hidden), bandaged hands held before him. Tie his hair back at the nape. Keep the upper third (shadowed rafters and dim wall above Nagoji's head) low-detail for four short lettering areas.

decisions.issues: The cast and blocking are right. The official is at screen right on a raised seat with steps (topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, shoulder cloth, palm leaf and stylus), with Nagoji and Ibrahim below him at screen left. Ibrahim wears the vest with no coat. The setting breaks the scene: it is an outdoor courtyard in bright midday sun under open sky, with palm trees, tiled buildings and fort walls, instead of the low lamplit evening hall of 6.3 and 7.1. Also wrong: background guards in white turbans (the script says no turbans), a yellow/saffron pennant at top left that could read as the Maratha flag, and Ibrahim standing apart with his mouth closed rather than murmuring at Nagoji's shoulder.
decisions.correction: Set this indoors in the same low hall as 6.3 and 7.1, at evening by lamplight. Include carved dark wooden pillars, a timber-and-tile roof overhead, open brass oil lamps hanging on chains and standing brass lamps, a packed-earth floor with woven mats, and seated bare-chested Nair men in white mundus with topknots along the sides. Exclude open sky, palm trees, courtyard buildings, fort walls, daylight and any yellow or saffron flag. No turbaned guards: any guard is a Nair man with a topknot, bare-chested or in a short white cotton jacket, white mundu, spear and small round shield. Keep the previous composition and figures. The official sits at screen right on his raised wooden platform: older and heavy, bare torso, Kerala topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, white mundu, plain white shoulder cloth, tapping the edge of a blank palm leaf with his stylus. Nagoji stands barefoot at screen left below him in the cream tunic-shirt and dhoti, bandaged hands, hair tied back, clean chin, curled moustache, gold stud. Ibrahim stands close at Nagoji's shoulder, leaning toward his ear with lips slightly parted as he murmurs: cream pocketed vest over a white shirt and white mundu, white turban, short grey-flecked beard, one faint grey-white ash smear. The red banner with the silver conch may stay on the back wall. Keep the dark rafters above the figures low-detail for two long lettering areas.

decisions.issues: The official is right: heavy, patient round face, grey-streaked Kerala topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, plain shoulder cloth, chin on fist, stylus still, open brass lamp. The problem is the large over-the-shoulder foreground figure. It reads as Nagoji (cream tunic, curly hair) but shows a dark beard along the jaw, which breaks his clean-shaven chin. His hair is loose rather than tied back, and a brown strap he does not wear crosses his shoulder. The script wants the official alone; it lists no principals for this panel. Other problems: the background guard wears a white turban (the script says no turbans), the official sits at a European-style table rather than on his raised platform, and the rendering is photographic, unlike the inked panels on this page.
decisions.correction: Remove the over-the-shoulder foreground figure entirely. This is a close shot of the official alone, with no Nagoji, no back of a head and no shoulder in the foreground. Draw it in the same inked graphic-novel line-and-wash style as the other panels on this page, not as a photograph. Keep the official exactly as before: older and heavy, a patient round face, grey-streaked Kerala topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, plain white shoulder cloth, no thread or forehead marks, chin resting on his fist, the stylus held still above a blank palm leaf, an open brass oil lamp beside him. Seat him on his slightly raised wooden platform behind a low stack of palm-leaf records, not at a European-style table. Background: the dim hall with carved wooden pillars and open brass lamps hanging on chains. Any guard behind him is a Nair man with a topknot and no turban. Keep the top quarter of the frame (dark rafters and plain wall) low-detail for the long caption, and leave a second clear patch of wall beside his head for the question.

decisions.issues: v01 is the right shot: a reverse wide from behind the official's carved seat, a wooden-pillared hall with open brass lamps on chains (no glass) and the red conch standard, seated men on mats, Nagoji in the cream tunic and dhoti with bandaged wrists, Ibrahim beside him with no coat, a cream vest and a faint ash smudge, and a clean white wall band at the top for the three balloons. It still fails three checks. (1) Nagoji's long curly hair hangs loose down both sides of his neck to his shoulders. The bible row and the PRE-GENERATION NOTE require it tied back from page 3, and in 8.4 it is tied up, so the hair would change between panels on the same page. (2) The official in the foreground has a bushy grey beard showing along his jaw below the ear, and his topknot is jet black. Everywhere else he is clean-chinned with grey-streaked hair (7.4, 8.3, 8.4). (3) Ibrahim's head is turned toward Nagoji with his LEFT cheek to camera, but the scar from his left ear to his jaw is missing.
decisions.correction: Keep this composition exactly: reverse wide from behind the official's carved seat, his bare brown shoulder, white shoulder cloth and topknot dark in the near foreground; the wooden-pillared hall with open brass oil lamps hanging on chains; seated men in white turned on their woven mats toward Nagoji; Nagoji standing barefoot and upright at the edge of the central mat in the collarless cream tunic-shirt and dhoti, bandaged wrists, eyes on the official; Ibrahim (white turban, grey-flecked beard, cream vest over a white shirt, no coat, one faint ash smudge) leaning in at his shoulder; and the clean whitewashed wall band across the top for lettering. Fix three things. Nagoji's long curly hair is gathered and tied back at the nape, with only a few short curls at the temples, never hanging loose around his neck or shoulders. The official, seen from behind, has grey-streaked hair in his Kerala topknot and a CLEAN-SHAVEN jaw: no beard, whiskers or stubble visible along his cheek or jaw edge. Ibrahim's head is turned toward Nagoji so his LEFT cheek faces us: draw the thin pale scar running from his left ear down to his jaw on that visible cheek.

decisions.issues: The extreme close-up is well drawn: thick curled moustache, the chin cropped out of frame, no text, and open space at the upper right for the balloon. It fails for four reasons. (1) The setting is wrong. Behind him are open blue sky, a hilltop fort, palms and a stone fortification wall, which reads as outdoors. The scene is inside the official's wooden hall (8.1, 8.3). (2) The ear ornament is a large gold ball hanging from a hook, not the small gold stud the chapter checks and the prompt audit ask for. (3) His hair is loose, not tied back. (4) His brow is deeply knotted with forehead furrows, so the look reads strained and glaring rather than flat and certain.
decisions.correction: Keep the extreme close-up on Nagoji's eyes, nose and thick curled moustache, cropped just below the lips, and keep a plain, low-detail patch in the upper right for one balloon. Set it inside the same dim hall as the neighbouring panels: behind him only an out-of-focus dark carved wooden pillar, a whitewashed wall and perhaps a softly blurred open brass oil lamp hanging on a chain. NO open sky, hills, fort, palms or stone parapet. The upper-right lettering area is plain whitewashed wall or soft shadow. His long curly hair is gathered and tied back at the nape, with only a few curls at the temples. His ear ornament is a small gold stud sitting flush on the earlobe, not a ball hanging from a hook. His expression is flat and certain: the gaze level or a touch upward toward the official on his raised seat, steady and unblinking, brows straight and relaxed, no frown lines or forehead furrows.

decisions.issues: The official himself is right: in profile in the foreground, a grey topknot, grey moustache, clean chin, bare torso with a white shoulder cloth, the stylus lifted and the first smile showing. Everything else fails. (1) An unscripted European man in a brown coat sits among the 'seated men'. It reads as a Dutch or Portuguese presence in the hall during Nagoji's speech about them. (2) The seated men are on a raised bench, not cross-legged on floor mats as in 8.1, and a white-turbaned bearded man beside them could be taken for Ibrahim. (3) The 'leaf' is a broad folio on a European-style desk, with visible scribbled pseudo-writing at its right end. (4) The rendering is photographic, a clash with the inked graphic-novel style of 8.1, 8.2, 8.4 and 8.5. (5) The brass-helmeted guards and the stone balustrade do not match the hall in 8.1.
decisions.correction: Keep the official in profile in the near foreground at this size: older and heavier, round face, grey-streaked Kerala topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso with a plain white shoulder cloth, the stylus just lifted off the leaf, and the first trace of a smile at the corner of his mouth. Draw everything in the same inked and painted graphic-novel style as the neighbouring panels, not photographic. The setting is the same hall as 8.1: carved dark wooden pillars, whitewashed walls and open brass oil lamps hanging on chains. Beyond him, smaller and motionless, the seated men are local Kerala courtiers only: bare-chested or in plain white cotton, white mundus, topknots or white head cloths, sitting cross-legged on woven mats on the floor, not on a bench. There is NO European figure, no coats, and no white-turbaned bearded man who could be mistaken for Ibrahim. The leaf in front of him is one narrow palm-leaf strip on a low wooden rest, completely blank, with no marks, scribbles or writing of any kind.

decisions.issues: The beat is right. Nagoji makes a measured standing bow in the foreground: head lowered, hands at his sides, bandaged wrists, clean chin, moustache, hair tied. The official smiles in the mid-ground, matching 7.4 (grey topknot, grey moustache, clean chin, bare torso, stylus resting), and Ibrahim stands a step behind with no coat. It fails for three reasons. (1) Ibrahim's forehead has three crisp white horizontal stripes, a tripundra sect mark. The note allows at most a single faint grey-white smear, and the chapter checks forbid ash. (2) His scar is drawn on the cheek next to his visible screen-left ear, which is his RIGHT cheek. The scar must be on the LEFT. (3) The setting is a different place from 8.1: an open stone loggia with stone columns, a red canopy, a bay with a European ship and a hilltop fort, and no wooden pillars, hanging brass lamps or seated men. Minor: a dark smudge sits on Nagoji's cheek in front of his ear.
decisions.correction: Keep the composition: Nagoji in the left foreground, standing barefoot in the cream tunic-shirt and dhoti, head and shoulders inclined forward in a measured bow, not deep, hands at his sides with bandaged wrists; Ibrahim a step behind him in his white turban, grey-flecked beard, cream pocketed vest over a white long-sleeved shirt and white mundu, no coat; the official at right in the mid-ground on his raised seat, older and heavier, grey topknot, greying moustache, clean chin, bare torso, white shoulder cloth, a slight smile, the stylus resting. Set it inside the same hall as 8.1: carved dark wooden pillars, whitewashed walls, open brass oil lamps hanging on chains, a few seated men on woven mats in the background. NO stone loggia, sea, ships, hilltop fort or red canopy. Leave plain whitewashed wall high beside the official for his two balloons, and plain wall or shadow above and around Nagoji's lowered head for the two captions.
